about.title: Where every celebration feels personal
about.copyFirst: Varmala Palace – Banquet Hall & Marriage Lawn is a welcoming wedding venue in Bihar, created for celebrations that feel generous, graceful and beautifully yours. Across about 2 acres in Bhabua, Kaimur, the property brings together a spacious outdoor lawn, a banquet hall and dedicated car parking so every part of your gathering has room to breathe.
about.copySecond: Rooted in the warmth of traditional Bihari weddings, the setting is made for the full rhythm of the occasion: the joyful welcome, family rituals, music, a shared meal and the quiet moments between them. Clean AC rooms and restrooms help guests settle in comfortably, while a grassy children’s play area keeps younger visitors happily occupied. From decoration and sound system to generator backup, waiters and Jaimala or Varmala arrangements, customizable packages make planning feel clear and celebrations feel effortless. Better connectivity helps families arrive with ease.
